# RACECLUB
Start your engines and experience the thrill of true-to-life racing, with authentic physics and stunning visuals. **Get ready for the next level of racing!**


It's now in **Early Access**, with Multiplayer and much more to come.

# 🏎️ IMMERSE YOURSELF WITH REAL DRIVING FEEL
Race in immersive cockpit mode or switch to thumbstick controls and multiple camera views.
[media]

# 🔧CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAR
Pick your number, colours, and skin design to match your driving style and dominate the track.
[media]

# 🏁THEMED RACETRACKS
RACECLUB’s circuits are designed for pure driving pleasure, each racetrack offers a unique mix of speed, elevation, cornering, and challenge.
[media]

# 🔥FORMULA V12
Take the wheel of an F1-style racing beast powered by a roaring 12-cylinder engine. **Fast, sharp, and brutally responsive.** It's just you, the track, and raw power.
[media]

# ⚡FORMULA ELECTRIC
 Inspired by Formula E design, it combines lightweight handling, instant electric torque, advanced aerodynamics, regenerative braking, and multiple power modes. 
[media]

# 🚀 GAME MODES
- **HOTLAP:** Race against the global ghost cars and chase the best lap times on every track. 
- **DUEL:** Put your skills to the test against a challenging AI rival in the Duel mode.
- **RACE:** Battle against 7 AI rivals in a non-stop climbing race. Coming Soon!
- **MULTIPLAYER:** Coming Soon!

**Join RACECLUB Community:** https://discord.gg/SJPKwujq2x
